summary: ADALIA AS (org. no. 898 886 182) is a private limited company (AS) based in Sandefjord, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2012-09-27. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 59.110 (Produksjon av film, video og fjernsynsprogrammer). In its 2025 accounts (company level) operating revenue was NOK 1.7 m and net income was NOK 349 139. CEO: Iren Therese Lervik; board chair: Iren Therese Lervik.
